survey: The object is a sci-fi control console shown in three-quarter view from the front left. The main body is a light-grey box with rounded edges. Its base sits flat on the riveted metal floor, and the contact edge and shadow read correctly. The top slopes down toward the viewer. A dark-grey control panel is set into this slope and faces up toward the camera at an angle. On the panel are two round dial gauges (one white, one green) at the upper left, eight push buttons in two staggered rows of four (red and yellow, each with a bezel ring) at the lower left, and a lever on the right. The lever's rod rises from a collar at the bottom of a vertical slot in a raised housing and ends in a red ball knob. A grey rail runs along the high back edge of the slope and caps the top of the box. The front face has a recessed drawer panel with a single bar handle, centred horizontally. The right side face shows the slope profile, which matches the top. Every part sits on or in the body, the buttons can be pressed, the lever can travel along its slot, and the drawer can open.
